scope.selection: The only complete 240-second paired seed in the original batch; all conclusions are conditional on this saved pair.

provenance.official_input_path: algorithm/命题1-低空经济场景下的物流无人机调度算法数据.csv

method.alignment: Stepwise last recorded global best at or before each time/iteration checkpoint; no linear interpolation.
method.time_axis: End-to-end clock from CSV read; source best-update solver time plus recorded construction_seconds.
method.iteration_axis: Same ALNS iteration index, limited to the smaller recorded iteration count; last best-update time is not the actual completion time of the checkpoint iteration.
method.operator_success: current_improvement_rate = accepted current improvements / uses; best_improvement_rate = global lexicographic best improvements / uses; neither isolates late-count improvements.
method.operator_denominator: Each iteration selects one destroy and one repair; analyze families separately, never sum both as independent observations.
method.quantiles: Linear interpolation on sorted samples at index (n-1)*p; late-only samples exclude lateness <=1e-9.

final_task_diagnostics.route_identity_caveat: All drones share the origin; drone IDs are exchangeable labels, so same-ID route differences are descriptive, not causal.

limitations: Only one completed long-budget paired seed; no population inference or significance claim.
Allocation simultaneously enables lazy repair and route-distinct regret; this is not a regret-only causal contrast.
Equal seeds do not preserve equal stochastic search paths after algorithm/weight choices diverge.
Final operator counters and weights have no timestamps or joint destroy-repair counts; phase-specific operator effects and attribution are unidentified.
Only global-best objective history is saved, not incumbent route/task histories, current-state history, rejected proposals or per-operator elapsed time.
Same-iteration alignment controls completed iterations, not neighborhood evaluation count, task rank work, temperature path or solution-state distribution.
Sequential run order is baseline then allocation for this seed; machine load/order and both enabled flags remain confounded.
Final per-task comparisons do not identify which tasks or moves caused earlier late-count transitions.

evidence: 同一seed1321的240秒运行内，allocation在[5, 10, 30, 60, 120]秒检查点词典序领先，在[180, 239]秒落后；不引用其他种子的短测来解释长测。
共同迭代上限16671时baseline为64逾期、allocation为65；最终分别63和65。吞吐差不能单独解释回退。
baseline完成17398轮、allocation完成16671轮；搜索吞吐分别73.00和69.96轮/秒。
allocation在46.89秒首次达到65逾期，之后未再下降；baseline在168.91秒达到64，238.58秒达到63。
allocation全局最优更新371次，高于baseline的327次；较多三级得分更新不等同于较少逾期任务。
regret2使用占比由18.28%升至35.61%，其接受率由38.70%升至80.36%。这是各自整段轨迹的描述统计。
最终17项任务从基线按时变成候选逾期，15项反向改善，逾期数净变化+2；总逾期分钟变化-182.533，航程变化-36.386km。
mechanism_hypotheses: 候选较早降低逾期数，随后在65这一第一目标水平上持续改善总逾期/航程；这与搜索集中于当前第一目标水平附近的解一致，但现有数据不能证明陷入哪个局部最优。
regret2更高的累计接受、奖励与使用占比，可能和自适应权重的正反馈及搜索方向改变有关；缺少时序权重、配对算子和被拒候选日志，不能断言它导致长测退化。
应优先在后续独立试验拆开lazy与route-distinct开关，并记录第一目标改善次数/归属与阶段算子统计，再检验候选机制；本诊断未启动这些试验。
